Also, at low catalyst we can see clearly if conversion completes or stalls (signature of irreversible deactivation).

Alternatively, varying substrate would help test M11 (S+cat deactivation), M16 (S+catS deactivation), vs others.

This complements the previous two runs (0.01, 0.1) giving three catalyst loadings for rate-order analysis, and increased substrate stresses M11/M16 (substrate-dependent deactivation).
